verses.1: And it happened on one of the thirteen years in the third month. It was a time when the Lord spoke to me.
verses.2: Man said to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and to his officials: “Who is greater than you in your greatness?”
verses.3: Look, Ashur Erez in Babylon was a beautiful tree with strong branches. Its trunk was straight, and among its branches there were knots.
verses.4: The waters covered him; the hills were filled with his presence. His rivers flowed around its edges, and its streams flowed towards all the trees in the forest.
verses.5: Therefore, its height surpassed that of all the trees in the forest. Its branches stretched far away, and its trunk extended over vast distances, from the waters of the river.
verses.6: In his creations, we found every corner of the heavens. Under his feet, all the creatures of the field were born. And in his shadow, many nations lived.
verses.7: And he grew in size over time, until his roots reached many depths in the water.
verses.8: They did not grow in the garden of God. Their branches did not resemble those of other trees. They were not like any other tree in the garden of God, in terms of their appearance.
verses.9: It was beautifully made, with many decorations on it. All the trees in the garden of God were jealous of it.
verses.10: Therefore, thus said Adonai YHWH: “Because you have grown too tall in stature, and your heart has become arrogant. Therefore, your crown will be given to those who are humble and lowly.”
verses.11: And I will hand him over to the hands of wild bulls. They will make of him a prey for their own use.
verses.12: And they were captured by the foreigners who were arrogant and cruel. They were taken to the mountains, and in every valley, their bodies were left lying there. Their bodies were torn apart in all the corners of the earth. All the people of the earth came down from above them, and they were destroyed.
verses.13: All the birds of the sky dwell upon its branches. And to its peaks, all the creatures of the forest lived.
verses.14: So that none of the trees in the sea will be lifted up from their positions. Nor will their roots be given to those who are heavy-laden. And none of the waters will stand on their heads, for they all belong to death. They are given over to the land below, among the people of Adam.
verses.15: As Adonai Yehovah said on the day Shaulah arrived: “I will place the mountains upon him, and I will prevent her from being destroyed. Many waters will cover him, and all the trees in the forest will grow upon him.”
verses.16: From the sound of his trumpet, nations were terrified. They fled from him; all the trees in the lower parts of the land were destroyed. All the good trees were cut down.
verses.17: They also descended with him to the depths of Horeb. Their seeds then settled in its shadow, within the land.
verses.18: To whom have you shown such kindness and generosity? You have brought the trees of Eden down to the lower lands. They will be buried beneath the ruins. That is Pharaoh’s land. And all his people, let them cry out, “Adonai, Jehovah!”
